profile: weight normalization: rescales a linear classifier's weight vector by dividing the weights by the magnitude of the weight vector. In two-class linear classification, this gives a consistent way to normalize the weights. In multi-class classification, each linear classifier's weights are normalized by the length of its normal vector, which contains all feature-touching weights.
